name: sap_sales_documents
statement: SELECT CAST(documents."posting_date" AS DATE) AS "posting_date", CAST(documents."document_id" AS INTEGER) AS "document_id", CAST(documents."document_number" AS INTEGER) AS "document_number", CAST(documents."document_kind" AS VARCHAR(20)) AS "document_kind", CAST(documents."customer_code" AS VARCHAR(15)) AS "customer_code", CAST(documents."customer_name" AS VARCHAR(100)) AS "customer_name", CAST(documents."invoice_amount" AS DECIMAL(19, 6)) AS "invoice_amount", CAST(documents."credit_amount" AS DECIMAL(19, 6)) AS "credit_amount", CAST(documents."currency" AS VARCHAR(3)) AS "currency" FROM (SELECT CAST(inv."DocDate" AS DATE) AS "posting_date", inv."DocEntry" AS "document_id", inv."DocNum" AS "document_number", CAST('Invoice' AS VARCHAR) AS "document_kind", inv."CardCode" AS "customer_code", inv."CardName" AS "customer_name", inv."DocTotal" AS "invoice_amount", CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19, 6)) AS "credit_amount", inv_cfg."currency" AS "currency" FROM "sap_invoice" AS inv CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX("MainCurncy") AS "currency" FROM "sap_company") AS inv_cfg WHERE inv."CANCELED" = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(cm."DocDate" AS DATE) AS "posting_date", cm."DocEntry" AS "document_id", cm."DocNum" AS "document_number", CAST('Credit Memo' AS VARCHAR) AS "document_kind", cm."CardCode" AS "customer_code", cm."CardName" AS "customer_name", CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19, 6)) AS "invoice_amount", cm."DocTotal" AS "credit_amount", cm_cfg."currency" AS "currency" FROM "sap_credit_memo" AS cm CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX("MainCurncy") AS "currency" FROM "sap_company") AS cm_cfg WHERE cm."CANCELED" = 'N') AS documents
description: One row per valid invoice or credit memo. Amounts are stored document totals in the company local currency.
